description.value: A backcountry campground deep in the Little Yoho Valley of Yoho National Park, reachable by trail only with a mandatory overnight permit and advance reservation; the Yoho Valley road is snowbound much of the year and no amenities are confirmed, making this a remote summer-only stop.
